simple.meaning: Lo-Ammi , the symbolic name of a son of Hosea
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לֹא עַמִּי (H3818) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.

simple.summary: לֹא עַמִּי (Lôʼ ʻAmmîy) means Lo-Ammi , the symbolic name of a son of Hosea First listed occurrence: Hos 1 9.

definitions.short: Lo-Ammi , the symbolic name of a son of Hosea
definitions.full: H3818. Lo Ammi עַמִּי לֹא proper name, masculine ( not my people: see לֹא 2d ) symbolic name of Hosea's son , Hosea 1:9 , compare Hosea 2:25 (see also 2:1 ; 2:3 ).
definitions.rootNote: from 3808 and 5971 with pronominal suffix; not my people ;
